Name: OrangePie's DCBurger style June (Ridgeside extra custom NPC) Portrait
Author: OrangePieUwU
Description:
High res portrait of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10100]June - Custom NPC for Ridgeside Village[/url] mod Character June, Since I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait[/url] for the main game I tried to draw in style that fits with DCBurger's portrait. Including beach portraits.


*Make sure you have [b]PyTK[/b] mod (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726)*
[b][size=4]PYTK unofficial update for 1.5.5: [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000]https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000[/url]﻿[/size][/b]
Find where you installed your June NPC mod (somewhere in [b]Stardew Valley\Mods[/b] folder)
Drag the "[b][CP] June NPC[/b]" folder from my zip to the [b]Stardew Valley\Mods\June NPC[/b] folder to overwrite the folder in it to install.

[b][size=3]*I would personally suggest using the no music or less music version June NPC mod on the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10100]June - Custom NPC for Ridgeside Village[/url] mod page, as huge custom music file eats memory up like crazy and causes OOM (Out Of Memory) errors.*[/size][/b]


Uploaded CP version.
*I would still recommend the replacement file version as the assets don't get loaded 2 times and are lighter to run.

Added another version in the optional file for people who want to install the portraits with portraiture.



Need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url] to work. (And ofc [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10100]June - Custom NPC for Ridgeside Village[/url] mod.)

The character belongs to the creator of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10100]June - Custom NPC for Ridgeside Village[/url]: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/123997133]ch20youk[/url], please go give them Endorsements and loves.
Ridgeside village belongs to the creator of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66167516]Rafseazz[/url], please go give them Endorsements and loves.
